d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ke philipins ki rajdhani manila pahunchne par bhartiy samuday ne garmajoshi ke sath unka svagat kiya. pradhanmantri ke aagman ko lekar bharatvanshiyon men khasa utsah dekhne ko mila. apne philipins daure ke dauran pradhanmantri aasiyan-bharat aur purvi eshiya shikhar sammelan men hissa lenge. is dauran aasiyan deshon ke sath bharat ke sanbandhon ko aur pragarh banane tatha vibhinn kshetron men aapsi sahyog barhane par vishesh jor rahega. vahin, jharkhand ke simdega se kangres vidhayak bhushan bara ke aavas se jure kathit yaun shoshan mamle men rashtriy anusuchit…
